references.producer: ORIGINAL routine, harness real driver, gfortran zero-init build

references.quantity: DDSDDE returned by the store OTI build
references.wrt: DSTRAN_j (engineering shear) or, for a gradient-driven source, the strain direction j pushed forward as dF = eps_j . F (Kirchhoff term added)
references.held_fixed: incoming STRESS_n, STATEV_n, STRAN_n, PROPS, TIME, DFGRD0 (and DFGRD1 for a DSTRAN-driven source)
references.scope: local: one increment from the recorded incoming state
references.reference: central FD of the ORIGINAL routine's STRESS_{n+1}, restored state

reproduce.freeze: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python tools/corpus_cases.py freeze --model parameter_sensitivity/models/sweep_maxwell_ve --family 'viscoelasticity / rate dependent' --tier ci
